title: Spicy Vegan Gimbap Rolls
description: A vegan twist on the classic Korean dish, featuring a delicious combination of tender vegetables and spicy tamarind sauce.
instructions: Prepare the Korean rice according to the package instructions.
In a large pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat. Add the sliced zucchini and grated carrots, and cook until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tamarind sauce and a pinch of salt and pepper. Pour the sauce over the cooked vegetables and stir to combine.
Cut the gimbap seaweed into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on the desired roll size.
Lay a piece of gimbap seaweed flat on a cutting board, with one edge facing you.
Spread a thin layer of the cooked rice mixture onto the seaweed, leaving a 1-inch border at the top.
Add a few pieces of the vegetable mixture on top of the rice, and sprinkle with chopped green onions.
Roll the gimbap tightly but gently, applying even pressure to form a compact roll.
Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients, and serve immediately.
